boundary_basis: Level08_EnterRoutine loads 0x000029E0 into A0 before calling VDP_WriteRotatingCommandRecord.
VDP_WriteRotatingCommandRecord reads one longword and one word, advances the cursor by six bytes, and wraps at the exclusive offset 0x60.
The sixteen six-byte records therefore occupy exactly 0x000029E0-0x00002A3F, immediately before SCENE_HEADER_VDP_WORDS at 0x00002A40.
